title: AC1021/AC1027 RASTERVARIABLES direct NOD owner profiles
scope: Two physical source witnesses confirm the direct NOD ACAD_IMAGE_VARS owner shape in AC1021 and AC1027. The adapter admits those same-revision direct-owner profiles, including the exact NOD soft-pointer reactor and missing-XDictionary flag observed in both files, while preserving the existing nested dictionary path. Generated ASCII/Binary controls cover field and reactor refusal, destination preservation, same-adapter retry, source-frame binding, and fresh typed readback.

physicalWitnesses.readerObservation: The focused libdxfrw adapter selector imported one generation-keyed typed object and matched its NOD entry, parent, reactor, XDictionary flag, class version, and modeled fields. The complete observed frame set also retains two AC1027 HEADER suffix-integrity rows; whole-source output remains refused.

The focused libdxfrw adapter selector imported one generation-keyed typed object and matched its owner and common metadata. The sample read remains partial: 40 unrelated object parse failures, 44 AC1021 CRC mismatches, and 40 failed source frames were observed. No whole-source output claim follows.

normativeSources.title: Autodesk RASTERVARIABLES (DXF)
supports: Group 330 names the ACAD_IMAGE_VARS entry in the named object dictionary as the RASTERVARIABLES owner.
Group 90 class version is fixed at 0.
Groups 70, 71, and 72 encode image frame, image quality, and insertion units.

normativeSources.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §§20.1 and 20.4.91
supports: Common object reactor references are soft pointers following the soft-pointer parent handle.
The RASTERVARIABLES body has class-version, display-frame, display-quality, and units fields followed by the parent and optional reactor handles.
For R2004+, the XDictionary missing flag controls whether an XDictionary handle is stored.

implementation.profile: Same-revision AC1021 or AC1027 only. A record must be reached once through either one complete NOD-owned dictionary or exactly one NOD ACAD_IMAGE_VARS entry directly targeting the typed record; the direct route's parent is the NOD. Common-link admission requires either no reactors or exactly one soft-pointer reactor to that same NOD, xDictHandle 0 with a 0/1 XDictionary flag, no data-storage bytes, no EED/XDATA, a unique handle, unchanged source CLASS/frame, and int16 modeled fields. Group 90 values other than 0 are refused.
implementation.graphOutput: The NOD traversal inventory admits a direct RASTERVARIABLES target only when the root key is ACAD_IMAGE_VARS, the object is staged by the extension graph, and its typed parent is the NOD. The exact one-reactor-to-owner-NOD edge is retained as a non-owning soft-pointer reference and does not recurse into the NOD as a reactor object. Generated AC1021 and AC1027 ASCII/Binary outputs read back the NOD owner entry, object parent, modeled fields, and reactor handle. The generated AC1027 nested-dictionary regression remains passing.
implementation.physicalExportLimit: The physical samples are used only for import/common-link corroboration. Cover.dwg retains two AC1027 HEADER suffix-integrity observations and a focused whole-source adapter attempt stops at the independent ACAD_LAYOUT entry-count gate. children-room-decoration.dwg has 40 unrelated object parse failures, 44 AC1021 CRC mismatches, and 40 failed source frames. This receipt does not claim either physical file converts, nor native image behavior.
